observedBehavior: Managed sessions bind to real workflow jobs, attempts and WorkItem execution links; unmanaged attempts retain native sessions.
Portable checkpoints resume as new managed sessions without reusing native harness session identifiers or expanding scope.
Delegation enforces child scope subsets, aggregate parent budgets, distinct agents, depth three and no active worktree sharing.
Delegation review requires a different human reviewer, child-job evidence and a different evaluator attempt.
Late attempt events no longer reopen terminal sessions.
Session details expose managed lineage, worktree, delegation, budget and checkpoint facts.
limitations: pnpm verify:fast remains red at Biome because of the pre-existing unused db parameter in apps/governor/src/modules/jobs/automation.ts:319; all other fast checks passed separately.
Documentation pack verification remains red because declared T54-T56 screen actions have no command DTOs/registry entries; no placeholder APIs were added.
OpenCode was verified as an explicit adapter selection; a new live OpenCode model run was not performed.
These results do not promote historical G01-G08 evidence or independently certify a release.
